aiOverview.content: Grainger uses a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and semantic search AI system—built with Databricks Mosaic AI and vector search—to help customers and call center agents navigate over 2.5 million maintenance, repair, and operations (MRO) products.Conversational Product Discovery: Handles over 40 million unique product queries on its e-commerce platform, helping B2B buyers find parts even when they lack exact technical specifications or combine brand and part descriptions in messy formats.Real-Time Data Synchronization: Processes over 400,000 daily product updates to ensure inventory and pricing accuracy across channels.Customer Support & Call Center Integration: Powers semantic retrieval and digital assistants that resolve roughly 40% of customer support questions end-to-end and reduce handling times for service agents.Hybrid Architecture: Combines centralized AI platforms with team-level deployment for field sales notes, digital assistants, and search workflows.Would you like to know more about how Grainger's e-commerce features work or details on other B2B industrial AI tools?Would you like to know more about how Grainger's e-commerce features work or details on other B2B industrial AI tools?AI responses may include mistakes.
